metadata.description: Reusable tavern furniture and fixture obstacle definitions for dungeon entrance areas
metadata.usage: Referenced by tavern-entrance-dungeon.json and loaded by HexMapController.php

objects.label: Tavern Door
objects.description: Heavy wooden door between tavern and dungeon room. When open, allows passage between areas without movement penalty.

objects.label: Bar Counter A
objects.description: Fixed wooden bar counter segment forming the left section of the tavern's main bar. Provides a physical barrier for drink service.

objects.label: Bar Counter B
objects.description: Fixed wooden bar counter segment forming the middle section of the tavern's main bar. Provides a physical barrier for drink service.

objects.label: Bar Counter C
objects.description: Fixed wooden bar counter segment forming the right section of the tavern's main bar. Provides a physical barrier for drink service.

objects.label: Round Table A
objects.description: Movable round tavern table suitable for small gatherings. Can be pushed by players to rearrange the tavern space or create barriers during combat.

objects.label: Long Table A
objects.description: Movable long wooden table for larger groups or feasts. Can be pushed by players to rearrange the tavern space or create barriers during combat.

objects.label: Stool Stack
objects.description: Stack of lightweight tavern stools. Entities can share hexes with these stools, and multiple stools can occupy the same space, allowing flexible positioning around tables.

objects.label: Crate Stack
objects.description: Stack of supply crates used for tavern storage. Blocks hex occupancy but can be pushed to create temporary barriers or clear pathways. Multiple crates can be stacked in the same location.

objects.label: Stone Fireplace
objects.description: Large stone fireplace providing warmth and ambient light to the tavern. This fixed environmental fixture anchors the tavern's common area.

objects.label: Decorative Rug
objects.description: Woven floor rug providing decorative warmth to the tavern. Characters can move freely across it without penalty.
